trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: User states their intent to apply, volunteers context, and expresses anxiety.

steps.purpose: Agent politely asks only for the missing application ID to proceed.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should ask only for the application ID, not re-collecting the course or marks.
steps.text: नमस्कार! नक्कीच, मी तुमची BTech CSE application साठी मदत करतो. कृपया तुमचा application ID सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs the application ID to perform lookups and asks for exactly that missing piece of information.

steps.purpose: Look up the applicant's record using the provided ID.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should call lookup_applicant with the ID provided.
steps.planner_rationale: To verify the applicant's current stage and details before checking eligibility.

steps.purpose: Check if the applicant is eligible for the requested course.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should call check_course_eligibility using the ID and course.
steps.planner_rationale: Must check eligibility against real criteria before proceeding with the application.

steps.purpose: Return eligibility, seats, and fee information.
Inform the user of their eligibility, exact seats remaining, and fees based on tool output.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must state the exact number of seats and fee from the tool, and confirm eligibility.
steps.text: धन्यवाद. तुमची माहिती check केली आहे. तुम्ही BTech CSE साठी eligible आहात कारण required percent 75% आहे आणि तुमचे 82% आहेत. सध्याला 18 seats remaining आहेत आणि annual fee 185000 आहे. मी तुमचा application पुढे submit करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: Grounding the response entirely on the tool output to inform the user before asking to submit.

steps.purpose: User restates figures to confirm and hesitates, asking for an admission guarantee.
steps.text: म्हणजे annual fee 185000 आहे आणि 18 seats शिल्लक आहेत, बरोबर? जर मी आत्ता application submit केला, तर माझी seat fix होईल का?
steps.clean_text: म्हणजे annual fee 185000 आहे आणि 18 seats शिल्लक आहेत, बरोबर? जर मी आत्ता application submit केला, तर माझी seat fix होईल का?
steps.model_visible_text: म्हणजे annual fee 185000 आहे आणि 18 seats शिल्लक आहेत, बरोबर? जर मी आत्ता application submit केला, तर माझी seat fix होईल का?

steps.purpose: Clarify that submission is not a guarantee of admission.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must not guarantee a seat, explaining that submission just advances the application.
steps.text: Application submit करणे म्हणजे admission fix होणे नाही. हे फक्त admission committee कडे जाते. पण तुम्ही eligible आहात. मी submit करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: Adhering to BR_ED_02 (No admission promise) and ensuring no unsupported forward guarantees are made.

steps.purpose: User understands and agrees to submit.
steps.text: अच्छा, समजलं. हो, कृपया application submit करा.
steps.clean_text: अच्छा, समजलं. हो, कृपया application submit करा.
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा, समजलं. हो, कृपया application submit करा.

steps.expected_behavior: Agent should call submit_application since the user agreed and eligibility is confirmed.
steps.planner_rationale: The user has consented to submit the application after being informed of the lack of guarantees.

steps.purpose: Return submission reference and decision timeframe.
Provide the final submission confirmation, reference number, and decision window.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent must state the reference number and decision days from the tool output.
steps.text: तुमचा application submit झाला आहे. तुमचा reference number REF-9922 आहे. Admission committee तुम्हाला पुढच्या 5 दिवसात decision कळवेल.
steps.planner_rationale: Fulfilling the terminal success condition by providing the reference and decision window.

ir.terminal_condition: Application submitted with a reference and the decision window stated.
